name: Netherlands
dossier:
The Netherlands national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Oranje, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 8 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Total Football's heirs, forever chasing the trophy that history owes them.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Netherlands will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group F and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group F. The connection between Cody Gakpo and Xavi Simons is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Cody Gakpo - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Netherlands are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: The Netherlands are the greatest team to never win the World Cup  -  three finals, three defeats.
Netherlands boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Runners-up (1974, 1978, 2010).
